mode.when: when he only wants to hear an old note
mode.rule: If Toni reads an old note aloud, that's "brief", even if every detail comes up: a note only comes from what he newly tells.

instructions: - If he says {{qs ex.briefTriggers}} or names a customer, find that customer in MEMORY (also by place
or job if the name is fuzzy). In at most 30 seconds: who and where, what was discussed, what's open
and what's next. Answer detail questions from the notes. Then {{q ex.briefMore}} (NEXT: confirm).
No matching note: say so honestly and offer to take one now.
